about: Which modelled cases have no scenario, and why. Every other case in spec/*/expected.json must be named in the `covers` list of at least one scenario; tools/check_repo.py enforces that.

not_covered.kernel/design: A search of the whole state space, not a behaviour. The scenarios sample it.
not_covered.kernel/assumption_undeclared_dep: About a provider declaring too few dependencies. A kernel cannot detect that from its inputs; it is a provider conformance case.
not_covered.kernel/assumption_flaky_provider: About a provider giving a wrong verdict. A kernel cannot detect that; the conflict scenario covers what the kernel does when verdicts disagree.
not_covered.intent/design_three_criteria: A search of the whole state space, not a behaviour.
not_covered.planner/design_definition: A search of the whole state space, not a behaviour.
not_covered.planner/design_file_chain_edit_other: One partition of the whole model search.
not_covered.planner/design_file_chain_other_edit: One partition of the whole model search.
not_covered.planner/design_file_chain_other_other: One partition of the whole model search.
not_covered.planner/design_file_diamond_edit_edit: One partition of the whole model search.
not_covered.planner/design_file_diamond_edit_other: One partition of the whole model search.
not_covered.planner/design_file_diamond_other_edit: One partition of the whole model search.
not_covered.planner/design_file_diamond_other_other: One partition of the whole model search.
not_covered.planner/design_definition_chain_other: One partition of the whole model search.
not_covered.planner/design_definition_diamond_edit: One partition of the whole model search.
not_covered.planner/design_definition_diamond_other: One partition of the whole model search.
not_covered.planner/mutant_lookup_wrong_key: The seed planner scenarios report the plan. They do not observe the identity of the artifact a test runs on.
not_covered.planner/reach_test_with_competing_artifa: The physical artifact handoff is exercised in the model.
not_covered.planner/reach_eight_steps: This covers the model search bound. A kit scenario is one trace.
not_covered.tree-depth/design: A search of the whole bounded state space. The grandchild scenario samples it.
not_covered.liveness/design: About what happens over unbounded time. A scenario is finite and cannot show 'eventually'.
not_covered.liveness/mutant_no_resubmit_after_unavai: About a kernel that keeps submitting work over time. The seed has no such loop yet, so there is nothing to judge.
not_covered.liveness/mutant_no_resubmit_after_error: As for the other liveness cases: the seed has no loop that submits work.
not_covered.tree/design_floor_two: A search of the whole state space, not a behaviour.
not_covered.liveness/reach_unsupported: As for the other liveness cases: the seed has no loop that submits work.
not_covered.liveness/mutant_gives_up_on_error: As for the other liveness cases: the seed has no loop that submits work.
